## What landed

- **`connectors/src/connectors/dot_511.py` (+391/−74)** —
  GeometryKind-driven dispatch: `assert_target_geometry_kind`
  validates the declared kind against the ontology `GeometryKind`
  enum at validate/expand/emit — a non-member raises
  `GeometryKindNotDeclared` (a registry defect, never a per-record
  rejection and never a silent point-flatten). `area_geometry()`
  serialises ArcGIS `rings` to WKT — CW exterior / CCW hole grouping
  under the most recent exterior, one exterior → `POLYGON`, several →
  `MULTIPOLYGON`; the centroid is DERIVED (shoelace centroid of the
  largest exterior ring, then through the same tier screen as any
  published coordinate). `_entry_from_raw` dispatches on the declared
  kind: `point` resolves the operator coordinate as before
  (byte-identical emit); `area` emits `geometry_kind` +
  `fixed_asset_location` (geometry-wkt) claims and never mints
  `camera_latitude`/`camera_longitude`; any other member
  (`line` today) fails closed `unsupported_geometry`. Per-row `where`
  (reviewed server-side filter — VT's `DeviceType='CCTV'`) and
  `out_fields` allowlists drive the ArcGIS query params; canary
  findings accept `rings` shapes.
- **`connectors/src/connectors/cli.py`** — `sig-connectors validate`
  gains the geometry-kind registry rule (SIG-GEO-003).
- **`dot_511_vocab.toml` → 2026.10.12.1** — `geometry_kind` +
  `fixed_asset_location` join the predicate allowlist (closed sink,
  SIG-INGEST-033; both registered predicates.yaml members); field
  aliases `Lon` (MiDrive title-case pair), `City_Ward`, `Loc_Name`,
  `LOCATION_PARTICULARS`. Additive only.
